title: Require fulfillment of the current pinned contract revision
preconditions: Use workplan fixture provider/consumer with handoff v1 and a contract_fulfilled dependency pinned to v1.

steps.action: Record accepted then fulfilled on the contract using current event parents; evaluate dependency.
steps.expected_result: The v1 dependency is satisfied with an empty blocker reason.

steps.action: Revise the contract to v2 with v1 as parent and a changed statement; reevaluate the unchanged v1 dependency.
steps.expected_result: It is unsatisfied with contract_revision_stale even though a fulfilled event exists.

expected_result: Fulfillment of a different current definition cannot satisfy the pinned gate.
